## Mermaid Diagram with classDef
 
This diagram should have custom colors. If it does not, something is
interfering with the rendering process.
 
```{mermaid}
graph TD
    A[Start] --> B(Process);
    B --> C{Decision};
``` 

```{mermaid}
  graph TD
      subgraph sg1 [My Subgroup]
          A --> B
      end

      style sg1 fill:#f0f8ff,stroke:#b22222,stroke-width:2px
```
   

```{mermaid}
%%{
  init: {
    "theme": "base",
    "themeVariables": {
      "primaryColor": "#fff",
      "primaryTextColor": "#fff",
      "lineColor": "#fff",
      "nodeBorder": "#fff"
    }
  }
}%%
graph TD
    A --> B
```
